mcq_drop.why: obscure statistics trivia (RTI pendency, committee-referral %) off-depth

patterns: Only PYQ here is an APPSC G1 multi-statement on PMLA (Director attaches proceeds of crime, in force 2005, Appellate Tribunal/Special Court); the notes also record APPSC items on CPI (perceived public-sector corruption) and the whistle-blower definition.
APPSC tends to test the statutory definition/agency-power wording rather than case law.
App goes well beyond PYQ depth (Sec 17A split verdict, UNCAC chronology, FEOA conditions, 2015 Bill), mostly sound but heavy on recent current affairs.
Common traps: 17A (approval before investigation) vs 19 (sanction before cognizance); PMLA enacted 2002 vs in force 2005; CPI scale 0 = highly corrupt.
